description: Sends an email invite to join the team as a client. Use when the user wants to add, invite or onboard a new client by email. Not for team staff or coaches (invite those in Teams). Returns the invite ID and status; a pending invite to the same email is updated instead of duplicated. Sends an email to the address given. Once accepted, the client counts toward the team's client limit, and acceptance fails when the team is at its limit.

email.description: Email address to send the invite to, e.g. "ana@example.com".

first_name.description: Client first name for the invite greeting, e.g. "Ana". Optional.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: invite_client
title: Invite client
